qualification: Counts classify explicit five-column TM tables. They include rejected experiments and parent machines; a class count is not a count of valid consistency machines. Dense 0 starts are recorded as a convention, not inferred fact.
identity_note: Complete traversal hashes classify spanning graphs exactly. Every nonspanning hash bucket is partitioned further by exact isomorphism, requiring a complete verified bijection. Counts use all working controls, not maximum reachable controls. Explicit starts and dense-zero conventions are recorded separately; the latter are not authoritative for native-numbered tables.
